## Before submitting - [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt). - [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes. - [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below. - [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). ## Affected area FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL ## Summary Two changes to the SM120/SM121 MXFP8 forward engine (`sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm120_mxfp8`), following #1599: 1. **D512 support.** New kernel `sm120/prefill_d512_mxfp8.py` serves both head dims in (256, 512], in multiples of 16. - It reuses the layout of the FP8 d512 kernel (`sm120/prefill_d512_fp8.py`): a 64x64 CTA with eight compute warps, two per 16-row Q slab, each owning half of the head dim. Every MMA is the block-scaled `mma.sync ... kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale ... m16n8k32`. - It serves the same features as the FP8 d512 row: masks, sliding window, sinks, GQA/MQA with PackGQA, split-KV, THD, base-2 Stats, Amax_O, and FP16 / BF16 / E4M3 / E5M2 O. The block-scaled MXFP8 O stays d128-only. - Pad rows, pad columns and KV blocks past the valid length use the unit scale, so stored pad scales (possibly NaN) never reach O. - The module docstring describes how Q, K and V scales are loaded. 2. **Faster d256.** MXFP8 graphs with Q/K head tiles of 224 or more now default to 64-key KV tiles. At these widths the 128-key tile crowds the compute warps' registers, and at (256, 256) it spills. The order lives in `config_sm120.kv_tile_preference`, and the heuristic, PackGQA plans and the adapter's default `tile_n` all follow it. The 128-key tile is still admitted, so a pinned or stored `TILE_N=128` builds. The MXFP8 general kernel (`sm120/prefill_mxfp8.py`) is unchanged. ## Why Before this PR, SM120 MXFP8 stopped at d = 256 and ran 1.28–1.39x slower than per-tensor FP8 there. This PR gives d512 MQA (DeepSeek-V4 style) an MXFP8 path and brings d256 (e.g. Qwen3.5) to 1.05–1.08x. ## Related issues Related to #381. Follows #1599. ## API and compatibility impact - No API or dependency changes. The engine stays opt-in (`CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`). - New eligibility: `sdpa_mxfp8` graphs with both head dims in (256, 512] on SM 12.x. - MXFP8 graphs with Q/K head tiles ≥ 224 default to 64-key KV tiles; `TILE_N=128` is still admitted. - SM121 is admitted by the cc 12.x row but not tested. ## Performance RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, SM clock locked at 85% of max and memory clock at max. Direct adapter, E4M3 inputs, BF16 O with Stats and Amax_O, default tiles. Each number is the median of 5 rounds of alternating processes; between-run CV ≤ 1.8% on every leg. D256, per-tensor FP8 vs MXFP8 before and after: | Shape | FP8 (µs) | MXFP8 develop (µs) | MXFP8 this PR (µs) | develop / FP8 | this PR / FP8 | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | B1 H16/16 S4096, non-causal | 477.6 | 661.7 | 521.4 | 1.39 | 1.08 | | B1 H16/16 S4096, causal | 261.9 | 336.4 | 275.8 | 1.28 | 1.05 | | B2 H32/8 S8192, causal | 3481.6 | 4694.0 | 3731.2 | 1.35 | 1.07 | | B1 H32/2 S8192, causal | 1775.7 | 2435.0 | 1887.9 | 1.37 | 1.07 | Other wide Q/K heads, MXFP8 on the 128-key tile (the previous default) vs the new 64-key default: | Shape | 128-key (µs) | 64-key (µs) | 64 / 128 | |---|---:|---:|---:| | B1 H16/16 S4096 D(256, 224), non-causal | 491.5 | 471.7 | 0.96 | | B2 H32/8 S8192 D(224, 224), causal | 3287.5 | 3207.4 | 0.98 | | B1 H16/16 S4096 D(224, 256), causal | 280.4 | 259.7 | 0.93 | | B2 H32/8 S8192 D(256, 128), causal | 2874.4 | 2776.0 | 0.97 | Narrower Q/K heads (e.g. (192, 192), (128, 256), (64, 256)) are 1–10% faster on the 128-key tile and keep it. D512, per-tensor FP8 (`prefill_d512_fp8.py`) vs MXFP8 (`prefill_d512_mxfp8.py`): | Shape | FP8 (µs) | MXFP8 (µs) | MXFP8 / FP8 | |---|---:|---:|---:| | B2 H16/1 S4096, non-causal | 2185.1 | 2248.3 | 1.03 | | B2 H16/1 S4096, causal | 1151.1 | 1174.4 | 1.02 | | B1 H32/8 S8192, causal | 4479.3 | 4572.2 | 1.02 | | B2 H128/1 S2048, causal, 128-token window | 703.8 | 715.0 | 1.02 | | B2 H64/1 S8192, causal, 128-token window | 1405.8 | 1432.7 | 1.02 | `benchmark/attention_training/benchmark_single_sdpa.py` shows larger d512 gaps because its `fp8` leg writes E4M3 O and its `mxfp8` leg writes BF16 O. ## Testing - RTX 5090: the SM120 FP8 / MXFP8 forward suites (command below), 1641 passed, 389 skipped. The skips are other-arch suites, two-GPU cases and rows that decline by design. - RTX PRO 6000: the MXFP8 forward, prepared and staged suites (291 passed) and the >2**32-byte stride cases (24 passed). - SM121 is not tested. New tests: - **d512:** masks, both input dtypes, every O dtype, envelope head dims (3-plane scale tiles), poisoned pads with sinks, PackGQA, persistent CTAs, split-KV, windowed MQA, THD (both Stats layouts), no-Stats, conversion layouts, base-2 Stats, routing, and the prepared / staged plans including >2**32-byte strides. - **d256:** numerics on both KV tiles; both tiles admitted by the heuristic and the adapter; PackGQA plans follow the tile order.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * MXFP8 attention on SM120 now supports head dimensions up to 512, including dimensions above 256, with the appropriate kernel selection. * Expanded support covers varied layouts, masks, grouped-query attention, and windowed attention. * **Bug Fixes** * Improved tile selection for larger MXFP8 dimensions and packed grouped-query workloads. * Improved handling of MXFP8 scale storage when selecting plans within shared-memory limits.

## Before submitting - [x] I agree to license this contribution under the terms of [LICENSE.txt](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/LICENSE.txt). - [x] I ran `pre-commit run` and committed any formatting changes. - [x] I reviewed the Hard Rules in the `AGENTS.md` for each directory this PR touches (see [root AGENTS.md § Reviewing a PR](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/blob/develop/AGENTS.md#reviewing-a-pr-human-or-agent)) and my changes comply, or I explain the exception below. - [x] I added GitHub labels: one `cat-*`, one or more `area:*` / `op:*`, and one `orig-*` (see [label list](https://github.com/NVIDIA/cudnn-frontend/labels)). ## Affected area FE OSS kernels or CuTeDSL ## Summary Two changes to the SM120/SM121 MXFP8 forward engine (`sdpa_fwd_prefill_sm120_mxfp8`), following #1599: 1. **D512 support.** New kernel `sm120/prefill_d512_mxfp8.py` serves both head dims in (256, 512], in multiples of 16. - It reuses the layout of the FP8 d512 kernel (`sm120/prefill_d512_fp8.py`): a 64x64 CTA with eight compute warps, two per 16-row Q slab, each owning half of the head dim. Every MMA is the block-scaled `mma.sync ... kind::mxf8f6f4.block_scale ... m16n8k32`. - It serves the same features as the FP8 d512 row: masks, sliding window, sinks, GQA/MQA with PackGQA, split-KV, THD, base-2 Stats, Amax_O, and FP16 / BF16 / E4M3 / E5M2 O. The block-scaled MXFP8 O stays d128-only. - Pad rows, pad columns and KV blocks past the valid length use the unit scale, so stored pad scales (possibly NaN) never reach O. - The module docstring describes how Q, K and V scales are loaded. 2. **Faster d256.** MXFP8 graphs with Q/K head tiles of 224 or more now default to 64-key KV tiles. At these widths the 128-key tile crowds the compute warps' registers, and at (256, 256) it spills. The order lives in `config_sm120.kv_tile_preference`, and the heuristic, PackGQA plans and the adapter's default `tile_n` all follow it. The 128-key tile is still admitted, so a pinned or stored `TILE_N=128` builds. The MXFP8 general kernel (`sm120/prefill_mxfp8.py`) is unchanged. ## Why Before this PR, SM120 MXFP8 stopped at d = 256 and ran 1.28–1.39x slower than per-tensor FP8 there. This PR gives d512 MQA (DeepSeek-V4 style) an MXFP8 path and brings d256 (e.g. Qwen3.5) to 1.05–1.08x. ## Related issues Related to #381. Follows #1599. ## API and compatibility impact - No API or dependency changes. The engine stays opt-in (`CUDNN_FRONTEND_ENABLE_FROST_ENGINES=1`). - New eligibility: `sdpa_mxfp8` graphs with both head dims in (256, 512] on SM 12.x. - MXFP8 graphs with Q/K head tiles ≥ 224 default to 64-key KV tiles; `TILE_N=128` is still admitted. - SM121 is admitted by the cc 12.x row but not tested. ## Performance RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, SM clock locked at 85% of max and memory clock at max. Direct adapter, E4M3 inputs, BF16 O with Stats and Amax_O, default tiles. Each number is the median of 5 rounds of alternating processes; between-run CV ≤ 1.8% on every leg. D256, per-tensor FP8 vs MXFP8 before and after: | Shape | FP8 (µs) | MXFP8 develop (µs) | MXFP8 this PR (µs) | develop / FP8 | this PR / FP8 | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:| | B1 H16/16 S4096, non-causal | 477.6 | 661.7 | 521.4 | 1.39 | 1.08 | | B1 H16/16 S4096, causal | 261.9 | 336.4 | 275.8 | 1.28 | 1.05 | | B2 H32/8 S8192, causal | 3481.6 | 4694.0 | 3731.2 | 1.35 | 1.07 | | B1 H32/2 S8192, causal | 1775.7 | 2435.0 | 1887.9 | 1.37 | 1.07 | Other wide Q/K heads, MXFP8 on the 128-key tile (the previous default) vs the new 64-key default: | Shape | 128-key (µs) | 64-key (µs) | 64 / 128 | |---|---:|---:|---:| | B1 H16/16 S4096 D(256, 224), non-causal | 491.5 | 471.7 | 0.96 | | B2 H32/8 S8192 D(224, 224), causal | 3287.5 | 3207.4 | 0.98 | | B1 H16/16 S4096 D(224, 256), causal | 280.4 | 259.7 | 0.93 | | B2 H32/8 S8192 D(256, 128), causal | 2874.4 | 2776.0 | 0.97 | Narrower Q/K heads (e.g. (192, 192), (128, 256), (64, 256)) are 1–10% faster on the 128-key tile and keep it. D512, per-tensor FP8 (`prefill_d512_fp8.py`) vs MXFP8 (`prefill_d512_mxfp8.py`): | Shape | FP8 (µs) | MXFP8 (µs) | MXFP8 / FP8 | |---|---:|---:|---:| | B2 H16/1 S4096, non-causal | 2185.1 | 2248.3 | 1.03 | | B2 H16/1 S4096, causal | 1151.1 | 1174.4 | 1.02 | | B1 H32/8 S8192, causal | 4479.3 | 4572.2 | 1.02 | | B2 H128/1 S2048, causal, 128-token window | 703.8 | 715.0 | 1.02 | | B2 H64/1 S8192, causal, 128-token window | 1405.8 | 1432.7 | 1.02 | `benchmark/attention_training/benchmark_single_sdpa.py` shows larger d512 gaps because its `fp8` leg writes E4M3 O and its `mxfp8` leg writes BF16 O. ## Testing - RTX 5090: the SM120 FP8 / MXFP8 forward suites (command below), 1641 passed, 389 skipped. The skips are other-arch suites, two-GPU cases and rows that decline by design. - RTX PRO 6000: the MXFP8 forward, prepared and staged suites (291 passed) and the >2**32-byte stride cases (24 passed). - SM121 is not tested. New tests: - **d512:** masks, both input dtypes, every O dtype, envelope head dims (3-plane scale tiles), poisoned pads with sinks, PackGQA, persistent CTAs, split-KV, windowed MQA, THD (both Stats layouts), no-Stats, conversion layouts, base-2 Stats, routing, and the prepared / staged plans including >2**32-byte strides. - **d256:** numerics on both KV tiles; both tiles admitted by the heuristic and the adapter; PackGQA plans follow the tile order.
Test command (from test/python) ``` pytest -m 'L0 or L1' -rs \ sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_mxfp8_sm120.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_prepared_mxfp8.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_heuristics.py \ sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_fp8_sm120.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_split_kv_sm120.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_prepared_sm120_mxfp8.py \ sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_staged_sm120_mxfp8.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_staged_forward_mxfp8.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_prepared_sm120_fp8.py \ sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_staged_forward_sm120.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_staged_forward_half.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_prepared_block_output.py \ sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_api_contract.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_fwd_placement.py sdpa/frost/test_split_kv_heuristic.py \ sdpa/test_mxfp8_block_scaled_fold.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_native_sm120_binding.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_native_mxfp8_binding.py \ sdpa/frost/test_mxfp8_sf_desc_shared.py sdpa/frost/test_sdpa_mxfp8_sf_bind.py ```
🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * MXFP8 attention on SM120 now supports head dimensions up to 512, including dimensions above 256, with the appropriate kernel selection. * Expanded support covers varied layouts, masks, grouped-query attention, and windowed attention. * **Bug Fixes** * Improved tile selection for larger MXFP8 dimensions and packed grouped-query workloads. * Improved handling of MXFP8 scale storage when selecting plans within shared-memory limits.
